verdict: Spend is producing purchases, not leads — the funnel is leaking at the lead capture step.
diagnosis: This period brought only 2 leads on $5,717 spend, pushing cost per lead far above the $98 wellness benchmark.

signals.headline: Only 2 leads this period
signals.detail: The Belle Watch campaign generated just 2 leads across 28 days despite reaching 41,055 people.

signals.headline: 9 purchases worth $5,897
signals.detail: Purchase revenue nearly matched spend of $5,717, showing bottom-funnel intent even while lead capture underperforms.

signals.headline: Cost per landing page view hit $24.87
signals.detail: Latest-period cost per landing page view spiked well above the 28-day average of $1.88, signaling recent efficiency loss.

signals.headline: Click-through rate sits at 0.08
signals.detail: Engagement is thin versus the healthcare Facebook range of 0.6–1.4%, suggesting creative fatigue on the retargeting audience.

signals.headline: 124 direction requests, 1 call
signals.detail: Google Business Profile drove foot-traffic intent but almost zero phone contact, a missed conversion path for a medical alert buyer.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.subheader: Wellness cost per lead sits near $98
benchmark.body: <cite index="5-13">B2C healthcare cost per lead ranges from $98 (wellness) to $661 (facilities)</cite>. Liferun's $5,717 spend produced 2 leads this period — roughly $2,858 each, far above category norms.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.body: <cite index="4-9">Health and fitness click-through rates dropped 6.6% year over year in Q1 2026, with campaigns competing in more crowded auctions</cite>. Expect continued pressure on impression share through August.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.body: <cite index="11-1,11-2">The medical alert systems market grew from $11.73B in 2025 to $12.61B in 2026, projected to reach $20.29B by 2032</cite>. Life Alert and Bay Alarm remain dominant brand-search competitors.

recommendations.title: Rebuild the lead form path before adding spend
recommendations.detail: Consider auditing why only 138 landing page views produced 2 leads. Test a shorter form, phone-first capture, or click-to-call given the older target demographic.

recommendations.title: Refresh creative on the retargeting audience
recommendations.detail: The Asian retargeting ad set is showing fatigue signs at 1.63 frequency. Worth testing new creative angles or expanding beyond the 50% video-view pool.

recommendations.title: Capture Google Business Profile intent with call assets
recommendations.detail: 124 direction requests produced only 1 call. Test call extensions and a click-to-call ad variant to convert local intent into booked conversations.
